gallery.title: App gallery
gallery.description: Free tools for support teams, each verified to be embeddable in the panel.
gallery.order_lookup.name: Order lookup
gallery.order_lookup.description: Shows the customer's orders next to the conversation and adds an order summary to a note or reply in one click. Our open-source sample app.
gallery.order_lookup.setup: Deploy the sample app (full source in the Order lookup sample guide) on your own server and enter its URL. After saving, add the app ID from its card to the app's settings.
gallery.calendly.name: Calendly scheduling
gallery.calendly.description: Find a meeting slot for the customer during the conversation and share your booking link.
gallery.calendly.setup: Enter your Calendly scheduling link (e.g. https://calendly.com/your-team/30min).
gallery.uptime_kuma.name: System status (Uptime Kuma)
gallery.uptime_kuma.description: See your services' live status next to the conversation and give customers accurate information during an outage.
gallery.uptime_kuma.setup: Enter your Uptime Kuma status page URL. To allow embedding, set UPTIME_KUMA_DISABLE_FRAME_SAMEORIGIN=true on your Uptime Kuma instance.
gallery.google_docs.name: Support handbook (Google Docs)
gallery.google_docs.description: Open your team's guidelines and reply rules from the menu in one click.
gallery.google_docs.setup: In Google Docs, go to File → Share → Publish to the web → Embed and enter the /pub?embedded=true URL it gives you.
gallery.metabase.name: Support dashboard (Metabase)
gallery.metabase.description: Follow the reports and targets you built in Metabase without leaving the panel.
gallery.metabase.setup: In Metabase, create a public link from the dashboard's sharing menu and enter the /public/dashboard/… URL.
gallery.openstreetmap.name: Branch and warehouse map
gallery.openstreetmap.description: Show your branches, warehouses or service areas on an OpenStreetMap map.
gallery.openstreetmap.setup: On openstreetmap.org, pick your area and enter the embed.html URL from Share → HTML. The sample URL shows Istanbul.
developers.title: For developers
developers.description: When it opens, your app receives a short-lived signed context token and can request actions such as adding notes or sending replies, only with the permissions you grant.
